replicated_originals.reference: Morriss, Macdonald & van Reekum (2016a) What is going on around here? Intolerance of uncertainty predicts threat generalization

A.reason: The paper states 'we attempted a three-lab direct and conceptual replication of Morriss and colleagues' (2016a) original results' (IU and threat generalization, uneasiness ratings and SCR); the Reading lab ran the direct replication and McGill and Texas A&M ran conceptual replications.

B.reason: Morriss, Christakou & van Reekum (2016b, fear extinction) is cited only as background evidence that IU modulates threat generalization and responses to generalized stimuli; it is not the study being replicated.

notes: There is one original study, tested at three sites: a direct replication (same lab, same paradigm) and two conceptual replications that add ERP/LPP measures. Nelson et al. (2015) is cited as a contrasting finding and was not replicated.
